about: A valuation is supermodular when RI ≤ 0 on every pair. Monotone and
supermodular gives g ≡ 0: planning is worth nothing. Height on a modular lattice
is modular, hence supermodular. A cheap join on B2 is not.
The trap: checking only chains, where every monotone function of
rank is supermodular because there are no incomparable pairs.

coverage.criterion: a chain (yes), B2 under height (yes), B2 under a cheap join (no)
